method_description: Fixed HH, 30 m native linear-power multilooking, exact unbuffered OSM mask, per-date threshold 0.6 times exterior reference median power. No official-data threshold/polarization/buffer fitting.

analysis_policy.land_reference: Complete coarse cells in actual cached AOI outside projected geographic reservoir bbox; cache extends approximately 600 m around bbox. Not a ground-truth land mask or the review screenshot's 5.1 km reference.
analysis_policy.scale_selection: Exploratory five-scale comparison, not independent held-out validation. 30 m is the finest listed scale meeting grade A for both core reservoirs. 10 m also has r > 0.85 for both but Baoshan II interval lower bound is < 0.6.

evaluation: Descriptive associations, not independent predictive validation. Paired bootstrap assumes exchangeable dates; temporal dependence may narrow intervals optimistically.

quality_policy.publication_statistics: All observations retained; exclusions are reported separately.
quality_policy.interpretation: Brightness/area anomaly flags; not inferred rain or wind causes.

display_range_basis.HV: Outward integer rounding of pooled 2nd/98th percentiles of all valid published display pixels across four reservoirs and 21 dates.

full_storage_repeatability.interpretation: Observed full-pool repeatability; not isolated sensor error.

polarization_comparison.date_selection: Lowest observed storage date, compared with the highest observed storage on or before that date; ties use the earliest acquisition.
polarization_comparison.interpretation: HH shows a larger decline in candidate-water extent for the core reservoirs. Dark exposed bed in HV is a hypothesis without independent land-cover truth. QA exclusions are sensitivity checks; publication grades retain all dates.

storage_volume_m3.unit_evidence: Official reservoir table labels data-key Capacity as effective storage in ten-thousand cubic metres and displays formatValue(e.Capacity) directly. Its newer Daily API mapping assigns EffectiveStorage to Capacity. Historical measurements remain the original GetComparision cache, not a replacement with current Daily values.

effective_capacity_m3.status: Unavailable in the historical response; values remain null.
effective_capacity_m3.policy: Never infer effective capacity from storage rate or a news constant.

notes: Uses official water levels; this is not an independent validation.
The range varies the classification ratio from 0.5 to 0.7.
Surface area is linearly interpolated between successive observations.
A gap greater than 36 days ends the evaluated observation block.
Report only; closure is not a publication-grade criterion.

threshold_sensitivity.policy: Unchanged 30 m native analysis grid and unbuffered OSM mask. Otsu uses each date's valid quantized dB samples inside that mask. Definitions are descriptive alternatives; none select the published ratio 0.6.
